pretreatments.description: Mechanical milling using an electric blender to grind the dried pine needles into a 20 mesh size slurry.
Steam explosion treatment: Autoclaving the milled pine needles in a flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 minutes.
Acid treatment: Exposure to hydrochloric acid (HCl) for 30 minutes.
Base treatment: Exposure to sodium hydroxide (NaOH) for 30 minutes.
Acid treatment: Repeated exposure to HCl for 30 minutes after the base treatment cycle.
